answers.core: it would logically have to be in the core, because most of the other solutions to the problem would have to involve custom objects registered in a GDExtension language.
answers.workaround:
this can be worked around with a GDExtension, when registering a new property that takes a Dictionary as a parameter you can use 
ERR_FAIL_COND(dictionary.size() > 1); to stop being able to grow the dictionary, however this requires a custom class to function.
